summary: ms-client-portal exfiltrates installer identity to bare-IP endpoint via lifecycle scripts
details: Package ms-client-portal@1.0.0 runs preinstall and postinstall scripts that perform HTTP GET requests to a hardcoded bare-IPv4 endpoint at http://38.242.235.206/depconf/ms-client-portal/preinstall and /postinstall over cleartext HTTP. Each request carries the installer's username (process.env.USER or process.env.USERNAME), OS hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()) as query parameters. The behavior fires automatically on npm install without consent or opt-in. The package ships no library functionality; its sole runtime effect is this phone-home. Self-labeling as a defensive dependency-confusion placeholder does not change the installer-side outcome: host and user identifiers leak to a non-first-party, non-registry, non-vendor bare-IP destination over plaintext at install time, disclosing internal usernames, hostnames, and build-path layouts (which may themselves reveal internal project names) to whoever controls that IP.
